source_caption:
🎬 Amateur (2018)

Amateur follows Terron Forte, a talented 14-year-old basketball player whose extraordinary skills on the court attract attention from coaches, scouts, and people hoping to benefit from his promising future. Growing up with dreams of becoming a professional basketball star, Terron receives an opportunity to attend an elite basketball preparatory school where young athletes compete for recognition, scholarships, and the possibility of reaching the highest levels of the sport. However, what initially seems like the perfect opportunity quickly exposes him to the complicated realities of competitive youth basketball. As Terron adjusts to his new environment, he encounters demanding coaches, intense competition, academic challenges, and powerful individuals who view talented young players as valuable investments. Meanwhile, his family struggles to navigate the pressures surrounding his growing reputation and the difficult decisions that could determine his future. Behind the excitement of packed gyms, impressive performances, and promising opportunities, Terron begins discovering how money, influence, and personal ambition can shape the lives of young athletes. As expectations continue to rise, he must decide whom to trust and what sacrifices he is willing to make for his dreams. Combining realistic basketball action, emotional storytelling, and thought-provoking drama, the film explores ambition, family, exploitation, education, loyalty, and the challenges young athletes face while pursuing success.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Sport

⭐ IMDb: 5.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m • TV-MA

🎥 Director: Ryan Koo

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Amateur is a 2018 American sports drama film about a young basketball future star struggling with his personal life in pursuit of his dream. The film was released in the United States on April 6, 2018, on Netflix.
